{{Quote|Go back to scratching your lice before somebody dunks you in a vat of mynock juice.|alyssaroxu, to wampa1|<ref name="Everyone's a Critic">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050331b|text=Everyone's a Critic}}</ref>}}
'''Mynock juice''' was a type of liquid. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Cularin holonet node]] user [[alyssa]]roxu posted a comment on the node in which she warned fellow user [[wampa1]] that someone would dunk him in a container of [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]] juice if he continued to post disruptive and opprobrious remarks on the forum.
